review_scope: Offline derivative privacy and content-quality preflight only. This review does not authorize hosting, scheduling, or publication.
review_method: Inspected full-duration 2 fps contact sheets and dense transition and boundary samples for all three derivatives.
Inspected every frame of the approved derivative in six sequential 30 fps contact sheets.
Required opaque removal of property identifiers and rejected any derivative with an address visible in a kept pixel.

decisions.review_note: The property identifier stays inside the fixed opaque mask in every rendered frame. Edit sale, Delete, confirmation, and the bounded Deleting state remain visible; no post-cut screen or private record appears.
The opening transition exposes a street address outside the first frame-bounded address mask.
The final UI update exposes demo addresses above the fixed list mask, and enlarging the mask would obscure the feature.
